analyzed_vuln.description: `QueryOps::completeMolQueries()` incorrectly assumes every atom query is an `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY` and performs an unchecked `static_cast` (`auto *query = static_cast<ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY *>(atom->getQuery());`). For this PoV, the parsed mol block creates an `AtomAnd` query (`Queries::AndQuery<int, const Atom*, true>`), so the cast is invalid and UBSan reports a bad downcast at QueryOps.cpp:963. The recursive helper `completeQueryAndChildren()` also blindly C-casts children to `ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY*`, compounding the same type-confusion assumption.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Data flow: `MolDataStreamToMol()` parses the mol block, `finishMolProcessing()` sees `_NeedsQueryScan` and calls `QueryOps::completeMolQueries()`. The PoV includes an `M  RBC` property that leads to a composite atom query (`AtomAnd`) instead of a simple equality query. Any input that sets `_NeedsQueryScan` and leaves at least one atom with a non-`ATOM_EQUALS_QUERY` (e.g., `AtomAnd`) will trigger this undefined behavior when `completeMolQueries()` runs.
